1080p.BBCIP.WEB-DL.AAC.2.0.H.264

Scottish DJ, producer and global superstar Calvin Harris returns home for a hugely anticipated show, live from Glasgow’s legendary Hampden Park. Celebrating an extraordinary 20-year career, the prolific hitmaker has amassed over 56 billion streams, won multiple awards and boasts 11 UK number one singles, making him the dance act with the most chart-topping records in history.

Just 20 years after playing his first ever gig to around 300 people at Glasgow's King Tut's Wah Wah Hut, the Dumfries-born artist transforms the country's national stadium into a giant open-air club. He performs a career-spanning set packed with era-defining anthems, spectacular production and euphoric moments for more than 50,000 fans, his biggest Scottish crowd to date.
